lines.trans: Tell me more about the two boys on Rue des Tilleuls, Madam Odette!

words.gram: noun, feminine singular, with elided article la

lines.trans: The older brother was lively and loud, always in a hurry to finish his scales.
And the little brother with the wooden train?
Quiet as a mouse! He sat on the third step to listen to every note.
Listening to the sound of the room... wait a second!
Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded softer in the rain.
Because wet wooden shutters soften the echo from the cobblestones...
Mr Antoine! Were you standing right there?!

words.gram: subject pronoun, 2nd person, formal (agent to his star)

lines.trans: Good heavens... look at those eyes! Little Antoine from the third step?!
Madam Odette?! My brother's Friday piano teacher?!
Wait: then Monday night on our step... the second blue suitcase...
Yes, Claire. That blue suitcase is mine, and I owe you the whole truth.

examples.text: Le grand frère était vif et bruyant, toujours pressé de finir ses gammes.

examples.text: Il y a vingt-cinq ans? Dans cette même maison?
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago? In that same house?

meanings.note: Irregular plural: les yeux.

examples.text: Les yeux il y a deux ans.
examples.trans: Her eyes two years ago.

examples.text: Elle a les yeux bleus.
examples.trans: She has blue eyes.

meanings.note: Un professeur de judo. Derived with the Romance agent/quality suffix '-eur'/'-euse' (from Latin '-or'/'-tor'). Standard masculine noun meaning 'teacher, instructor'.

examples.text: C'est un bon professeur.
examples.trans: He is a good teacher.

examples.text: Madame Odette?! La professeure de piano du vendredi de mon frère?!
examples.trans: Madam Odette?! My brother's Friday piano teacher?!

examples.text: Excusez-moi, madame... attendez. Cette voix! Madame Odette, ma professeure de piano?!
examples.trans: Excuse me, madam... wait. That voice! Madam Odette, my piano teacher?!

meanings.note: Contraction of de + le. In la cause du décès it connects the cause with the death being discussed.
for things you can't count; de la (feminine)

examples.text: C'est du compost.
examples.trans: It's compost.

examples.text: Je veux du pain.
examples.trans: I want some bread.

examples.text: Vendredi à onze heures.
examples.trans: Friday at eleven.

examples.text: À vendredi!
examples.trans: See you on Friday!

meanings.note: Jeudi, alors.

examples.text: Alors, tu viens?
examples.trans: So, are you coming?

examples.text: Alors pourquoi on ne la loue jamais aux clients?
examples.trans: Then why do we never rent it to guests?

meanings.note: Lundi prochain = next Monday.

examples.text: Lundi prochain?
examples.trans: Next Monday?

examples.text: À lundi!
examples.trans: See you on Monday!

examples.text: Oh, c'est la valise jumelle du train de lundi?
examples.trans: Oh, is that the twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Ce soir = tonight.

examples.text: Je ne peux pas venir ce soir.
examples.trans: I can't come tonight.

examples.text: À ce soir!
examples.trans: See you tonight!

meanings.note: Plural nos.

examples.text: Deux de nos acteurs.
examples.trans: Two of our actors.

examples.text: C'est notre agence.
examples.trans: It's our agency.

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'second'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Oui, la chambre quatre au deuxième étage! Comment était votre voyage en train?
examples.trans: Yes, room four on the second floor! How was your train trip?

examples.text: Bienvenue à l'Hôtel du Tilleul, Claire. Votre deuxième jour ne sera pas ennuyeux.
examples.trans: Welcome to the Hotel du Tilleul, Claire. Your second day will not be boring.

examples.text: Pas mal pour un deuxième jour, la nouvelle.
examples.trans: Not bad for a second day, rookie.

meanings.note: faire sa valise = to pack one's bags

examples.text: Porter une valise.
examples.trans: To carry a suitcase.

examples.text: Oh, c'est la valise jumelle du train de lundi?
examples.trans: Oh, is that the twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Descriptive French adjective meaning 'blue'; agrees in gender and number with the noun it modifies.

examples.text: Elle porte une belle robe bleue pour la soirée.
examples.trans: She is wearing a beautiful blue dress for the evening.

examples.text: Je voudrais un steak cuit bleu, s'il vous plaît.
examples.trans: I would like a steak cooked very rare, please.

examples.text: Oui, oui.
examples.trans: Yes, yes.

examples.text: Oui, je sais.
examples.trans: Yes, I know.

meanings.note: Place: à Paris, à mon cours.
Time: à midi.

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
meanings.note: Contractions.

examples.text: Je suis à Paris.
examples.trans: I'm in Paris.

examples.text: À quatorze heures.
examples.trans: At two pm.

meanings.note: Stressed form: pour moi, avec moi.

examples.text: Et moi?
examples.trans: And me?

examples.text: Moi, c'est Henri. Vous êtes en avance de dix minutes.
examples.trans: I am Henri. You are ten minutes early.

meanings.note: + infinitive.

examples.text: Salut! Tu dois être Claire. Moi, c'est Nadia, de la cuisine.
examples.trans: Hi! You must be Claire. I am Nadia, from the kitchen.

examples.text: La cliente de la chambre quatre reste toute la semaine. Tout doit être parfait!
examples.trans: The guest in room four is staying all week. Everything must be perfect!

examples.text: Je dois lire le cahier de réservations, mais je ne trouve pas mes lunettes!
examples.trans: I need to read the reservation book, but I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: Tout va bien.
examples.trans: Everything is going well.

examples.text: Madame Odette, tout va bien? Vous avez sonné!
examples.trans: Madam Odette, is everything alright? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Dire la vérité = to tell the truth.

examples.text: Dis la vérité!
examples.trans: Tell the truth!

examples.text: Tu n'as jamais dit la vérité sur nous!
examples.trans: You never told the truth about us!

meanings.note: À bientôt = see you soon.

examples.text: À bientôt!
examples.trans: See you soon!

examples.text: Il arrive bientôt.
examples.trans: He's arriving soon.
